final: SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_mem, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) GROUP BY entrystat
